browsers.name: Chrome
browsers.notes: The tab must remain visible. Chrome has no battery-saver check: Battery Saver and Energy Saver do not refuse the lock.

browsers.name: Edge
browsers.notes: The tab must remain visible. Sleeping tabs affect only tabs in the background.

browsers.name: Firefox
browsers.notes: The tab must remain visible. Refuses and releases the lock at 5% battery or less while not charging. Earlier versions use the video fallback after a user gesture.

browsers.name: Safari
browsers.notes: Needs a tap to start. The tab must remain visible. iPhone Low Power Mode caps Auto-Lock at 30 seconds.

browsers.name: Samsung Internet
browsers.notes: The tab must remain visible. Power-saving settings can close the browser after you leave it.

browsers.name: Opera
browsers.notes: Chromium-based support; the tab must remain visible.

extension.name: AwakeTab for Chrome
extension.notes: Works while the browser is running, including hidden tabs and minimised windows. Keep-alive alarm every 30 seconds on Chrome 120 and later (60 seconds on Chrome 116 to 119). Does not prevent sleep when a laptop lid is closed. Firefox and Safari have no power API for extensions.

contexts.name: iOS Home Screen app
contexts.notes: Older versions should use AwakeTab in Safari.

contexts.name: Video fallback
contexts.notes: Requires a user gesture and uses more power than a native wake lock.
